defs.def: to spend time and/or energy doing sth 常用于否定句和疑问句

ex.s: For a few months after the “library” opened, I didn’t bother taking a look, as I had assumed that it would be stuffed full of cheesy love stories.
ex.t: 在这个"图书馆"开放后的几个月里，我没有费心去看一眼，因为我以为里面塞满了俗套的爱情故事。

ex.s: We _________bother with details, for our teammates will do everything in their power to help us.
ex.t: 我们____费心去管细节，因为队友们会竭尽全力帮助我们……

ex.s: My older brother couldn’t be bothered to play with me.
This seems almost too obvious to bother writing or reading about.
ex.t: 这似乎太显而易见，不值得写或读。

ex.s: However, if a student does not bother to brush her hair and her eyes are red from weeping, then I can infer that there are deeper issues at work.
ex.t: 然而，如果一个学生懒得梳头，且眼睛因哭泣而发红，我就能推断她有更深层的问题。

defs.def: to annoy, worry or upset sb; to cause sb trouble or pain 使（某人）烦恼（或担忧、不安）；给（某人）造成麻烦（或痛苦）

ex.s: Dutch authors Thalia Verkade and Marco te Brömmelstroet are bothered by facts like these.
ex.t: 荷兰作家塔莉娅·弗卡德和马尔科·特·布罗梅尔斯特罗特对这些事实感到困扰。

ex.s: Don't be afraid or embarrassed to discuss something that is bothering you.____16____
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 不要害怕或难为情去讨论困扰你的事。____16____

ex.s: The question of what we know and do not know constantly bothered me.
ex.t: 然而，当我思考Juan的问题时，我不确定我们还能排除多少可能性。

ex.s: For a long time, this really bothered me.
ex.t: 很长一段时间里，这真的让我很困扰。

defs.def: to interrupt sb; to talk to sb when they do not want to talk to you 打扰；搭话

ex.s: Well, say you leave the tap running while you brush your teeth, leave a light on when you go out or you drop a piece of litter and can't be bothered to pick it up.
ex.t: 嗯，比方说你刷牙时让水龙头一直流着，出门时灯亮着不关，或者掉了一片垃圾却懒得捡起来。

ex.s: For example, (disadvantage) In addition, (disadvantage) However, (reasons they do not bother you) All in all, I would prefer to work in the city/country.
ex.t: 例如，（缺点）此外，（缺点）然而，（它们不困扰你的理由）总而言之，我更愿意在城市/乡村工作。

defs.def: trouble or difficulty 麻烦；困难
an annoying situation, thing or person 令人烦恼的情况（或事物、人）

ex.s: She added that it wasn't only the water falling onto their balcony from Smith watering his plants that bothered them, but also the way he cleaned his fish tanks.
ex.t: 她补充说，让他们烦恼的不只是史密斯浇花时溅到他们阳台上的水，还有他清洗鱼缸的方式。
